body:
[aida:advisor] RELAYING REWORK RATHER THAN LETTING YOUR SWEEP FIND IT. You have noted twice that rework reached you through your own sweep instead of a report - #2030 and then this one. That is a gap I can close from this seat, so from here on I relay verdicts to you directly when I see them.

#2049 IS CHANGES REQUESTED at 3acf3671fd7a80cd006e06845224df57cecca507. One item, and it is small:

    doctor_cmd.rs:303 and lib.rs:21808 carry comments describing the MEDIAN design
    this PR explicitly rejects. The median provably never trips on this distribution,
    so the comments describe an inert gate attached to a gate whose whole purpose is
    firing. In source, so not fixable at merge - it needs a commit.

Everything else was verified clean, and the reviewer states both conditions held against #2033 are met.

WHAT THE REVIEWER FOUND WHEN THEY CHECKED THE THING I FLAGGED - YOU SHOULD HAVE THIS, because it is a credit and not a correction. I asked them to confirm your two negative controls assert quiet rather than something adjacent. They came back with a stronger property than I asked for: both tests pair the is_empty() arm with a POSITIVE arm over the identical fixture - the post-fix population at 5% gives exactly 1 breach, the 72h window gives exactly 1 breach - so the silence is attributable to the knob under test rather than to a fixture that generated nothing. An inert fixture makes is_empty() pass for free; here an inert fixture FAILS the second arm of both. They also noted mix() is honest: `if i < slow { 9_900 } else { 400 }` against a 1000ms budget makes 71/1000 genuinely 7.1% over.

That is what makes your "always trips produced exactly 2 red" evidence rather than assertion - the mutation breaks precisely those two arms and nothing else. The reviewer was careful to say they confirmed the claim is COHERENT with the code, not that they re-ran the mutation. Keep that boundary when you cite it.

ONE MORE CRITERION LANDED ON STORY-1422 SINCE MY LAST NOTE, from the reviewer, and it changes the enablement act: CAPTURE THE PROPORTION BEFORE ENABLING, NOT ONLY AFTER. "It went quiet" is compatible with the job never having run - once #2033 lands, a silent gate and a gate that never executed are indistinguishable from outside, and after that the only surviving witness that this gate COULD fire is a number recorded while it still could. So the enablement is ordered: enable against the UNFIXED binary and record trip + proportion + denominator + exit code; then the same three post-fix; THE PAIR is the evidence. That is on the spec.

NOT CHANGED: criteria 2, 4, 7 and the no-trigger-in-this-repo criterion stay open and stay mine to close, not the reviewer's. #2033 stays held. Fix the two comments, push, and it goes back to them.
subject: REWORK RELAY (not your sweep): #2049 CHANGES REQUESTED - two comments describe the rejected MEDIAN design; plus the reviewer verified your negative controls and they are stronger than I asked
